Detached traditional home offering exceptional potential, requiring modernisation
Generous plot with low-maintenance gardens and ample off-road parking
Deceptively spacious accommodation with 3 reception rooms

summary: A fantastic opportunity to acquire a detached family home, in need of modernisation, on the edge of a highly sought-after village in the Northern Fells section of the Lake District National Park. Offering flexible living with 3 reception rooms, 4 double bedrooms, and low-maintenance gardens.
description:
Occupying an enviable position within a charming and picturesque village in the Caldew Valley, in the tranquil Northern Fells section of the Lake District National Park, this appealing detached residence enjoys excellent accessibility to Keswick, Penrith and Carlisle, and lies just one mile from Caldbeck with its range of amenities and well-regarded primary school.

Requiring sympathetic modernisation and priced accordingly, the property presents a rare opportunity to create an exceptional Lake District home of considerable character and distinction.

Set within a generous, low-maintenance plot with ample off-road parking and an attractive cottage garden frontage, the deceptively spacious accommodation briefly comprises a vestibule leading to a sitting room, kitchen/dining room and a garden room. A rear extension provides a useful scullery/store together with a ground floor bathroom and WC.

To the first floor are four well-proportioned double bedrooms.

A cherished family home for many years, early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the setting, potential and charm on offer.

Directions From Penrith head north on the M6 turning off at junction 41 taking the B5305 towards Wigton. After approximately 7 miles turn left towards Hesket Newmarket. On entering the village Caldew Villa is the second house on the right hand side.

Services Mains electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • The property is in a national park.
